Definition: properly, a mesh (as allowing a liquid to run through), i.e. coarse loose cloth or sacking (used in mourning and for bagging); hence, a bag (for grain, etc.)
BiblicalUsage: 1) mesh, sackcloth, sack, sacking; 1a) sack (for grain); 1b) sackcloth; 1b1) worn in mourning or humiliation; 1b2) same material spread out to lie on
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
